name: singleRecord
description: Forces all the collected rows to generate a single output record.

name: extends
description: Can be used to build a template file out of another file.

name: recordXPath
description: For each match of this selector a new record is generated with scoped extraction relative to the match

name: recordSelector
description: For each match of this selector a new record is generated with scoped extraction relative to the match

name: fields
description: A list of fields that need to be extracted from the page.

records.name: jq
records.description: A valid JQ filter. Not all JQ features are currently supported. Only works on text nodes - cannot be used for attributes.

records.name: regExp
records.description: A valid regular expression. The value returned for this field will be the complete regex match unless regExpReplace is used.

records.name: regExpReplace
records.description: Use $1, $2, ..$N to inject the regex group capture inside a new recomposed result.

records.name: defaultValue
records.description: Populate the field when the used selector did not match. However a default value will only be generated if a record is generated.

records.name: screenCapture
records.description: Generates a field with a screenshot of the page.

records.name: type
records.description: Specify a type casting for the field value.

records.name: downloadContent
records.description: The part of the collected node which contains the url to download the desired item. In doubt use 'text'.
